227943214_5852be8b.text: The ventral tegmental nuclei of Gudden send a dense GABAergic projection to the medial mammillary bodies

227943214_598f569f.text: Reciprocal connections between the lateral mammillary bodies and the dorsal tegmental nuclei of Gudden constitute the generative pathway of the vestibular head direction system. Thalamic projections of the lateral mammillary nuclei are exclusively to the anterodorsal thalamic nuclei
